text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss), lymphocytosis, elevated LDH, and the specific finding of a bulky, matted supraclavicular mass with abdominal lymphadenopathy is highly characteristic of this malignancy.
